Elena: Heads-up  found inconsistent terminology in the migration guide and some SDK snippets. People are using "model variant", "variant", and "model-variant" interchangeably. We should pick canonical forms for code vs prose.
Marcus: For code/config we should use param-case `model-variant`. For prose, use `model variant` (lowercase). For headings maybe Title Case: "Model variant".
Jin: Agreed. Also there's a handful of snippets still referencing `variantId` camelCase. That one breaks the snippet parser tests. I'll grep and list matches.
Elena: Example to fix in #2523:
```
# old
client.deploy(variantId='v2', model='redwood-1')

# new
client.deploy({'model-variant': 'v2', 'model': 'redwood-1'})
```
Priya: I can patch the snippet in #2523 and add a comment in the PR explaining param-case.
Marcus: Can we add a single-line rule in /docs/style.md: "Use param-case (kebab-case) for configuration keys and inline code; use natural prose (lowercase) for descriptions." Keep it terse.
Jin: I'll open a tiny docs CI rule to fail on `\bvariantId\b|\bmodelVariant\b` in docs/snippets. That should catch remaining cases.
DocsBot: heads-up: docs-snippet-test currently flagged 4 failing snippets referencing `variantId`.
Elena: Action plan: (1) Priya patches the three PR snippets she owns, (2) Jin adds CI grep, (3) Marcus adds the one-line style blurb + PR template checkbox. We should coordinate reviews so merges happen quickly.
Priya: On it. I'll drop comments and include the changelog note if snippet URLs change.
Marcus: I'll draft the style blurb and PR template edit.
Jin: Will push CI PR in ~30m.
Elena: Thanks. Once merged, run full snippet test job to confirm no more instances. :thumbsup:
DocsBot: job queued: docs-snippet-test (post-merge).
